note: The gauges' configuration and evidence (handoffs/control-board-plan/step3/sections/gauge-lifecycle.md). The site computes every stage from it (app/lib/ControlGauges.php); nothing here is a stage.

R01.name: Every method a file calls exists (a zip can't drop one still in use)
R01.target: 0 failures in the files it reads

R02.name: No alert(), confirm(), prompt(); use TvAsk
R02.target: 0 failures in the files it reads

R03.name: Uploads only through Uploads.php and /api/upload.php
R03.target: 0 failures in the files it reads

R04.name: No PHP the server can't run (readonly, enum, never on a function that can return (P8), first-class callables, array_is_list, json_validate, typed constants, new in defaults)
R04.target: 0 failures in the files it reads

R05.name: Pages load the session and draw the account bar
R05.target: 0 failures in the files it reads

R06.name: FAQ links point at questions that exist
R06.target: 0 failures in the files it reads

R07.name: Endpoints that change things check the security token (or a signature)
R07.target: 0 failures in the files it reads

R08.name: Migrations: add-only, safe twice, no IF NOT EXISTS in ALTER, no routines
R08.target: 0 failures in the files it reads

R09.name: Every page is in site-audit/pages.md or archive.md
R09.target: 0 failures in the files it reads

R10.name: The brand's icons, not emoji
R10.target: 0 failures in the files it reads

R11.name: No breadcrumbs on content pages
R11.target: 0 failures in the files it reads

R12.name: Every outside service the code calls has its card in Outside services: a host the site, its pages or the workers call that's on no card (OutsideServices::HOSTS or a card's links), or a standing source on Sources with no card (ignored hosts: site-audit/services-ignore.txt)
R12.target: 0 failures in the files it reads

R13.name: A new outside call (curl, an http file read, a socket) goes through staging's gate (StagingGate::hold(), or another gate), or says why not with an @gate note; the message names the function, so only a new one counts
R13.target: 0 failures in the files it reads

R14.name: A new table (a migration's or code's CREATE TABLE, AdminTables::make) has its class in app/lib/staging-tables.php
R14.target: 0 failures in the files it reads

R15.name: A worker's endpoint is named by a process in app/lib/ControlRegister.php (decisions/0171 §3)
R15.target: 0 failures in the files it reads

RENDER.name: The rendered check: each page in a real browser
RENDER.target: every page answers, with no console error, no failed request, no sideways scroll at 390 and card edges at 3px, as each account; the accessibility basics at WCAG 2.2 AA

PATHS.name: The paths check: what a visitor comes to do, end to end
PATHS.target: every path reaches its goal: 3 taps or fewer from home to a place to eat and to a town's guide, 5 or fewer for the rest

SEARCH.name: The search probe and its scorecard
SEARCH.target: every probe case passes; typing suggestions answer within 300 ms

LAYOUT.name: The layout probe: what a phone shows at the top of a page
LAYOUT.latest: 5px above the hero on a landmark and on Discovery (2026-11-21 10:19 UTC)
LAYOUT.target: no gap between the top bar and the hero; nothing drawn over a card's action icons

PHOTOS.name: Public photos load
PHOTOS.latest: exit code in the run only: no result kept in git
PHOTOS.target: a real stock and member photo answer 200 as an image; every kind reaches media.php

BOARD.name: The Control Board's readings: a workflow or service on real data
BOARD.target: its process working, with no open trip

TOOLS.name: Each tool and endpoint, used by every type of account
TOOLS.target: every tool does what site-audit/tools.md says, for every account that may use it, and is refused with the reason for every account that may not

LOAD.name: Load time for every page against a target
LOAD.target: Core Web Vitals "good": LCP ≤ 2.5 s, CLS ≤ 0.1, INP ≤ 200 ms, each at the 75th percentile

PHOTOS-SHOWN.name: Every photo on a page shown
PHOTOS-SHOWN.target: every image on the page loaded and drawn (decoded, wider than 0) and with a text alternative

BRAND.name: The brand and design standards on every page
BRAND.latest: partial: R10, R11 and the 3px edges only
BRAND.target: the readable standards of brand.md met: its tokens, one header per view, filters as one dropdown, card anatomy, icons; text contrast at least 4.5:1, focus visible

AUDIT.name: The audit's own load: what each run asks of the site
AUDIT.target: a light run asks at most about 20 requests, one at a time with a 1 s gap; the probe pages' response times stay within 20% of their 7-day median, or the next run backs off
